currentPhase.description: RC718 remains the frozen promoted legacy standalone product after RC719 PASS_WITH_RESERVATIONS. Stage B, Stage C and the controlled Stage D pilot remain accepted. ARC-WP-020 identity taxonomy remains accepted, but ARC-WP-021 supersedes its continuity path: no RC718 compatibility resolver, identity overlay, dual-read window or learner-state migration is planned. The next generation will use a new major contract, canonical identity from creation, isolated storage and an empty active state. Implementation remains blocked until the bounded clean-generation foundation gate is accepted.

activeRisks.statement: The main-protection ruleset is configured but not enforced on this private personal-account repository.
activeRisks.closureGate: move the repository to an eligible GitHub Team organization account or another topology that enforces private-repository rulesets

activeRisks.statement: The legacy Player working-file count is exactly 150. The clean-generation foundation must explicitly retain, reduce or replace this budget rather than growing around it.
activeRisks.closureGate: accept an exact new-generation file plan and source-budget decision

activeRisks.statement: The clean-break decision intentionally does not migrate RC718 library or learner data. User confusion or perceived data loss is possible if the new generation is distributed without explicit communication and preserved RC718 access.
activeRisks.closureGate: preserve retrievable RC718 access, publish an explicit rupture notice and pass a human release gate

activeRisks.statement: The RC719 promotion is recorded as accountable-owner PASS_WITH_RESERVATIONS without raw device recordings or per-case test logs.

activeRisks.statement: RC719 reservations remain unitemized, but they do not block a distinct clean generation and must not be silently copied into its scope.

nextMandatoryGate.condition: Design and authorize the minimum viable clean-generation foundation from exact current main. Define the new major content contract, isolated localStorage and IndexedDB namespace, canonical identity rules, empty initial state, regenerated Nombres complexes and Signaux électriques golden kits, exact Player file plan and source-budget decision, disjoint Stage D role scopes, negative proof that RC718 storage is untouched, deterministic build and release identity.
